note: Generation plan for the painted places (tools/gen_backgrounds.py). Every image = STYLE + the place prompt + RULES for its orientation, generated with STYLE REFERENCE paintings (style_refs + the same place's other orientation when it exists) so the whole library reads as ONE world. Files that already exist are skipped; 'remaster' re-paints the existing 1376px files at high resolution from themselves.
style: Soft 3D animated children's background in the exact same visual style as the reference images: premium preschool cartoon look, rounded chunky clay-like vinyl-toy shapes, smooth matte surfaces, bright cheerful pastel palette (mint, peach, butter yellow, lilac, sky blue, soft pink), warm soft daylight from the top-left with gentle bloom and soft ambient occlusion, slightly hazy distant layers, clean simple forms, no outlines, no film grain, no photorealism.

rules.wide: Wide 16:9 composition, camera at a small child's eye level, straight-on. The ground/floor fills the lower 40% of the frame; the area where characters will stand (the lower-middle 60% of the width, between 55% and 90% of the height) is open, flat and uncluttered. Props and tall objects stay at the left and right sides.
rules.tall: Tall 9:16 vertical composition, camera at a small child's eye level, straight-on. The ground/floor fills the lower 40% of the frame; the middle of the frame between 45% and 85% of the height is open, flat and uncluttered for characters. Props stay at the left and right edges; the sky or the back wall fills the top.
rules.always: No characters, no people, no animals, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no signature.
